title: No Falling Underground Gravel
description: Replaces annoying underground gravel clusters with a non-gravity-affected variant which can be broken with both a pickaxe and a shovel.
body:
This mod removes those annoying underground gravel patches encountered while mining, replacing them with Stony Gravel.

Stony Gravel is not affected by gravity and is mineable with both a pickaxe and a shovel. It can be crafted back into regular gravel in case of necessity. It drops flint at the same rate as regular gravel.

![Stony Gravel, Regular Gravel, and Suspicious Gravel arranged side by side](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/66c29795a724f83c25c74c04af0d3ddff329d235.png)
